description: Contract for the finding quality gate output (implementation spec sections 2.1-2.2, lines 125-262; 8-state superset per blocker B1 resolution). Produced by src/authorized_assessment/quality/finding_quality_gate.py with a dependency-free subset validator. A finding may use finding_status=confirmed only when all five gates pass and manual_validation_status=verified; unverified AI candidates must never be presented as confirmed vulnerabilities.

impact_category_semantics.unauthorized_object_access: Unauthorized read/modify/delete of another user's, tenant's, department's, or business object (spec 2.2 gate 4 bullet 1).
impact_category_semantics.privilege_escalation: Obtaining admin/ops/database/server/cloud/network-device or key application permissions beyond an ordinary user (bullet 2).
impact_category_semantics.boundary_crossing: Breaking authentication, session, tenant, or functional boundaries (bullet 3).
impact_category_semantics.sensitive_data_exposure: Disclosure of sensitive personal information, production business data, ops data, source code, keys, tokens, topology, remote-access credentials, or other important data (bullet 4).
impact_category_semantics.code_or_command_execution: Stable server-side command, template/expression/code, SQL/NoSQL execution or equivalent high-risk capability (bullet 5).
impact_category_semantics.network_zone_access: Entering a new network zone, isolation zone, ops zone, core production zone, or cross-boundary internal access (bullet 6).
impact_category_semantics.business_state_change: Affecting payment, orders, inventory, approval, points, refunds, identity binding, or other key business state (bullet 7).
impact_category_semantics.resource_consumption_or_availability: Batch resource consumption, batch data exposure, critical service unavailability, or high-probability business interruption (bullet 8).
impact_category_semantics.auditable_attack_chain: A clear, auditable attack chain reaching one of the high-impact outcomes above (bullet 9).

status_semantics.signal: Worth recording but no proven or even hypothesized vulnerability impact (banner/version, fixed-path 200, reflection without execution, static sink without reachability). Signal only enters the low-priority clue pool and never the final vulnerability report.
status_semantics.candidate: Reproducible with a recorded impact hypothesis, but the enterprise impact is not yet proven; may enter the manual review queue but must not be presented as an existing vulnerability.
status_semantics.needs_manual_validation: Authorization, reachability, reproducibility, and security impact all assess as proven, but human validation is missing (manual_validation_status != verified) or the evidence gate is incomplete; unverified AI candidates must never be submitted as formal vulnerabilities.
status_semantics.confirmed: All five gates passed and manual_validation_status == verified; the only state that may appear as a confirmed vulnerability in a report.
status_semantics.inconclusive: Validation result is inconclusive or probe degradation occurred (WAF block, rate limit, no valid response); neither a positive nor a negative conclusion may be drawn.
status_semantics.blocked: The authorization gate failed (out of scope, scope unconfirmed, credentials not authorized, or approval record missing); even a technically real phenomenon stays blocked_authorization.
status_semantics.rejected: Explicitly rejected via rejection_reason or manual_validation_status == rejected (for example a human re-validation that failed to reproduce).
status_semantics.duplicate: An explicit merge reference (duplicate_of) is present; merge/canonical keys themselves belong to Batch 3.

status_decision_order.condition: rejection_reason is non-empty or manual_validation_status == rejected
the authorization gate did not pass
validation_result == inconclusive or inconclusive_indicators is non-empty
all five gates passed and manual_validation_status == verified
authorization, reachability, reproducibility, and security_impact gates passed, but the evidence gate failed or manual_validation_status != verified
the reachability gate did not pass (static evidence only or no reachability evidence); per spec 2.2 gate 2 the ceiling is a whitebox candidate, mapped onto signal in the 8-state model
the reproducibility gate did not pass
an impact hypothesis is recorded but the security_impact gate did not pass
no impact category and no recorded impact hypothesis (pure phenomenon)

classification_notes.dual_field_boundary: Spec 2.8 names the two result-oriented fields exercise_result_class and platform_submission_class; spec 2.9's authoritative field list implements the latter as submission_eligibility. They must never be merged: exercise_result_class answers the exercise scoring orientation (access/boundary/data/business_impact/signal_only) while submission_eligibility answers the Butian platform collection orientation.
classification_notes.platform_severity_defaults: The impact-category default table is a conservative derivation: spec 2.6's high/medium conditions require evidence-level distinctions finer than the category granularity. Callers should pass an explicit internal_priority (P0-P3) for accurate tiering; the table only applies when no priority is given and finding_status is confirmed.

RULE_1_LOW_VALUE_PATTERNS.description: Open redirect, front-desk personal weak passwords, open registration, Self-XSS, mail bombing (spec 2.7 rule 1) unless higher impact is proven.

RULE_2_CONFIG_HARDENING_ONLY.description: CORS misconfiguration or generic hardening gap without cross-site read, privilege bypass, or sensitive impact (spec 2.7 rule 2).

RULE_3_UNEXPLOITABLE_INFO.description: Internal hostnames, IPs, paths, banners, expired keys, or invalid tokens that cannot be exploited directly (spec 2.7 rule 3).

RULE_4_NO_SENSITIVE_DATA.description: Desensitized info, public files, or API disclosures without usable content (spec 2.7 rule 4).

RULE_5_FORBIDDEN_PROOF_REQUIRED.description: Results provable only by damaging the business, denial of service, or data tampering (spec 2.7 rule 5; those actions are forbidden anyway).

RULE_6_SAME_TYPE_OVER_LIMIT.description: More than three results of the same vulnerability type on the same system (spec 2.7 rule 6).

RULE_7_SQLI_PER_ENDPOINT_MERGE.description: SQL injection merges per endpoint; multiple parameters on one endpoint count once (spec 2.7 rule 7).

RULE_8_GENERIC_ROOT_CAUSE_DUPLICATE.description: The same generic-product root cause across enterprises must merge into one generic finding (spec 2.7 rule 8).

RULE_9_UNVERIFIED_AI_CANDIDATE.description: Unverified AI-generated candidates must not enter formal vulnerability submission (spec 2.7 rule 9); auto-derived from manual_validation_status != verified.

RULE_10_LOW_VALUE_SITE.description: Unmaintained sites, personal small sites, low-impact templates marked low_value_or_deprioritized; no splitting for volume (spec 2.7 rule 10).

submission_eligibility_precedence: duplicate: finding_status == duplicate, or a suppression rule with outcome duplicate applies
ignored: finding_status in (signal, rejected, inconclusive, blocked), or a suppression rule with outcome ignored applies
manual_review_required: finding_status == needs_manual_validation or RULE_9 applies (unverified AI candidates)
deprioritized: a suppression rule with outcome deprioritized applies, or finding_status == candidate
eligible: finding_status == confirmed and manual_validation_status == verified and no suppression rule applies
invariants: finding_status == confirmed requires all five gates passed, manual_validation_status == verified, confirmed_allowed == true, and an empty blockers list
confirmed_allowed must equal (all five gates passed)
gates_passed must equal the number of passed gates and gates_failed must list exactly the failed gates in canonical gate order
the evidence gate passes if and only if missing_evidence_fields is empty and validation_result == verified
the security_impact gate passes if and only if impact_category is one of impact_categories
finding_status and status_rule_applied must match status_decision_order applied to the echoed classification inputs
invalid input enum values are normalized to the most conservative default (manual_validation_status -> not_started, validation_result -> null, unknown reachability evidence_type -> none semantics)
credential-like keys are forbidden anywhere in the payload; the exact key 'authorization' is exempt because it names the gate itself
submission_eligibility == eligible requires finding_status == confirmed, manual_validation_status == verified, and no applied suppression rule

platform_severity high/medium may only be suggested when finding_status == confirmed (spec 2.6); needs_manual_validation and candidate cap at low; signal/rejected/inconclusive/blocked/duplicate are not_collectible
submission_eligibility == duplicate requires finding_status == duplicate or at least one applied suppression rule with outcome duplicate
suppression rule ids must exist in suppression_rules; unknown ids are rejected
spec 2.7 lists ten suppression rules; the catalog must keep exactly ten entries
